title: A Versioned Unified Graph Index for Dynamic Timestamp-Aware Nearest Neighbor Search
abstract: arXiv:2608.27663v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present TiGER (Time-Integrated Graph for Efficient Retrieval), a novel approach for performing fast time-aware approximate nearest neighbor searches on dynamic vector datasets with flexibility over any possible time range. Our proposed algorithm builds and maintains a unified graph for all vectors by leveraging an index structure based on integrated versioned connectivity, allowing arbitrary time intervals to be queried directly on the unified graph without having to traverse invalid vectors. This forgoes the need for post-search filtering or merging, or separate graphs for each possible composite range. Empirical evaluations show that our method attains up to a 5x improvement in queries per second (QPS) without compromising accuracy over baselines based on filtering or per-time-segment sub-graphs. translated_title: 动态时间戳感知最近邻搜索的版本化统一图索引
translated_abstract: 我们提出了TiGER（Time-Integrated Graph for Efficient Retrieval，高效检索的时间集成图），这是一种新颖的方法，用于在具有任意时间范围灵活性的动态向量数据集上执行快速的时间感知近似最近邻搜索。我们提出的算法通过利用基于集成版本化连接性的索引结构，为所有向量构建并维护一个统一图，使得可以在统一图上直接查询任意时间区间，而无需遍历无效向量。这避免了搜索后过滤或合并的需要，也无需为每个可能的复合时间范围构建单独的图。实证评估表明，与基于过滤或按时间段子图的基线方法相比，我们的方法在保持准确性的同时，每秒查询数（QPS）提升高达5倍。我们相信，该方法将使实时推荐系统、日志分析等场景中不断演化的数据集的时间分析变得高效。
tldr: 提出TiGER方法，通过版本化统一图索引实现动态向量数据集上任意时间范围的时间感知近似最近邻搜索，无需搜索后过滤或为每个时间段维护单独的图，QPS提升高达5倍且不损失准确性。
en_tdlr: TiGER introduces a versioned unified graph index enabling fast timestamp-aware approximate nearest neighbor search on dynamic vector datasets over arbitrary time ranges, achieving up to 5x QPS improvement without sacrificing accuracy.
